output.content: I checked the configuration for the drift to alerting workflow this morning. The trigger field is empty. No threshold is defined, and no schedule is attached to the check. Because of this, the pipeline never initiates the alerting step on its own. I have to manually run the script from my local terminal to see if the model metrics have shifted. When I do, it takes about four minutes to process the latest batch of inference logs. I then compare the results against the baseline I set last quarter. If the numbers look off, I open a ticket in the issue tracker. This manual step happens roughly twice a week, usually on Tuesdays and Fridays, depending on when I remember to check the logs.
